title: paeonia tenuifolia f. latisecta
intro: Paeonia tenuifolia f. latisecta, commonly known as White Peony or Latisecta White Peony, is a plant species in the peony family (Paeoniaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to relieve menstrual cramps and other symptoms associated with premenstrual syndrome (PMS). The therapeutic actions of Paeonia tenuifolia f. latisecta include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its analgesic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
